verdict.rationale: ReelMimic uses an uploaded video only as a reference: it analyzes the shots, BPM, colors and framing, then generates a new 2D animation in one of its own styles. It does not edit the source footage. Its chat and timestamped comments request revisions to its own generated output, and nothing documents replacing or restyling a single element while the rest of the frame stays intact. That revision loop is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.
